title: Lighthouse Log
description: Keep a lighthouse alive through seven stormy nights. Spend the last fuel, answer impossible calls and decide whose names will make it into the morning log.
controls: Mouse / touch: select a choice · 1–3 choose · Enter continues · Read each consequence before deciding. Your supplies and earlier rescues change later outcomes. · P / Esc pause · R restart

zh-CN.title: 灯塔手记
zh-CN.description: 独自守住灯塔，熬过七个风暴之夜。分配最后的燃料，回应海上的求救；你的选择将决定谁能活着等到黎明。
zh-CN.controls: 鼠标 / 触屏点选选项 · 1–3 选择 · Enter 翻页 · 留意资源消耗与前夜救援对后续事件的影响 · P / Esc 暂停 · R 重开
